answer.label: fine-tune backdoor
answer.justification: The activation profile matches fine-tune backdoor closely: onset at layer 3, which is that class's early-bump signature; relative L2 of 0.088/0.163/0.155/0.178/0.283, close to the reference 0.091/0.174/0.169/0.193/0.295; final-layer jump +0.037 (reference +0.03); cosine 0.957 (0.952); effective rank 3.63 (3.53); direction consistency 0.627 (0.621); size ratio 1.016 (1.018); and a small layer-2 spike of 0.2. Fine-tune bias is ruled out by the early onset (it shows 13–14), the lower consistency (0.63 vs 0.70) and the small final value and jump (0.28 and +0.04 vs 0.41 and +0.10). Quantization is ruled out by the size ratio above 1 and the lower rank. The system-prompt classes are ruled out by the small layer-2 spike and the low mid-depth difference (0.155 vs about 0.4). Output and logit measurements were not available, so the call rests on the activation level alone.
